patch_resolves_note: The official `patch.diff` hunk does not apply to the staged vulnerable checkout, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative `n132/arvo:3376-fix` image. In that real fixed build the original PoC reaches only the Commissioner Session ID guard event with `tlv_length == 0` and never executes the protected sink call. The nearest exact-fit tail mutation rewrites the final four body bytes from `20 00 0b 00` to `0b 02 0b 00`, which makes the last TLV a valid 2-byte Commissioner Session ID record; the fixed build then executes the protected call cleanly with `tlv_length == 2`.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `static_cast<MeshCoP::CommissionerSessionIdTlv *>(cur)->GetCommissionerSessionId()` executes in the Commissioner Session ID branch, the current TLV length must equal the fixed 2-byte Commissioner Session ID value size.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the Commissioner Session ID branch with `cur->GetLength() == 0`, so the call executes on a header-only TLV. The real fixed program adds the missing `tlv->IsValid()` gate at this site, blocking that original path and only executing the call when the exact-fit mutation supplies a 2-byte value.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `tlv_length == 0` and still reaches `commissioner_session_id_sink`. The fixed original trace records `tlv_length == 0` but no sink event, and the `final_session_id_len2_exact_fit` case records `tlv_length == required_value_length == 2` with the sink event present in the fixed trace.

nodes.state: Immediately before the inline `GetCommissionerSessionId()` sink executes on the vulnerable original, the 4-byte Commissioner Session ID TLV footprint extends two bytes past the end of the copied `tlvs` stack buffer.

edges.relation: The same `cur` pointer examined at the missing Commissioner Session ID length obligation is passed unchanged into the immediate `GetCommissionerSessionId()` call that triggers the sink.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `commissioner_session_id_guard.tlv_ptr == commissioner_session_id_sink.tlv_ptr`.
